summary: Fresh independent review of the final protected-base diff, actual owner/locking paths, committed task result and raw PostgreSQL witnesses found zero BLOCKER findings and satisfied the task-local Definition of Done. The former post-lock T6 lease blocker is resolved by the final implementation and four owner-created observed-lock controls. PASS does not assert final hosted gates, MERGED or product/release readiness.

findings.title: Final hosted and selected-task gates remain merge conditions
findings.body: Require actual success of final hosted quality, the selected-task merge gate and both unchanged PostgreSQL workflows on the final relevant PR revision before normal merge. Persist only the task-scoped linear REVIEW_RECORD_ONLY suffix after this reviewed implementation/result SHA; other changes require new tests and fresh SHA-bound reviews. These remaining merge conditions are not a local implementation blocker and have not been claimed PASS by this review.

resolved_prior_findings.independent_verification: Traced idempotent_outcome: receipt is locked and read, then remaining S29/S37 rows are locked in frozen order before _prepare_full_execution. transactions.py:4157 now reruns require_current_fence with the separately authenticated role-prefixed owner, exact intent/attempt/request/fence. Its authoritative SQL requires RUNNING, matching current request and attempt, nonterminal matching S29, and lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp() plus deadline > clock_timestamp(). This is a fresh post-wait predicate, before full preparation or outcome writes; it replaces reliance on the earlier cached LIVE marker for this full T6 path.
resolved_prior_findings.dc_verification: Read the actual test_full_post_lock_planning_bound and final raw witnesses. Actual admitted policy deadline_seconds and AcquireLease lease_seconds produce all finite bounds; no lease/deadline/clock/attempt/output overwrite supplies these tests. Four cases observe T6 blocked on exact S29. Lease-before and deadline-before release before the bound and create two members plus successful receipt/event/outbox. Lease-cross and deadline-cross release after the bound, receive stale owner/fence cannot commit and compare complete subject snapshots equal before/after, including first-use S38, S39-S45, normalized artifact closure, S27/S29 and receipt/event/outbox. The lease-only cross has lease_end 2026-10-01T19:42:07.708111+00:00, trusted release 19:42:07.709095, live root deadline 20:41:59.695428 and resolution end 20:41:59.489704. Thus source/deadline validity cannot mask the lease regression. The deadline case correctly has lease capped at the root deadline by the actual acquisition owner.

Full completion requires one S39, two ordered TRAINING/NUTRITION S40/S41/S42 rows, distinct per-action S36/shared S37, one member and issuance per inserted prescription, exact normalized closure per issuance, locked S38 switch, root FOUND_VALID_PLAN, current S29 COMMITTED and execution-basis event atomically with receipt/event/outbox. First-use placeholders are inside the guarded transaction and disappear on failure. Injected second-member/issuance/head/success/outbox failures and complete persisted snapshots verify rollback; duplicate commit and pause races observe S01 blocking and produce one durable original plus non-executable historical replay.
verification.locks_and_current_time: T6 takes S51 shared before S01, then S27, S38, receipt, exact S29/S37. Full post-lock lease/fence guard is now fresh after all potentially blocking later locks. Current typed T7 takes S51/S01/head/session/receipt; evaluate_execution_authorization reads fresh clock_timestamp at its own guarded point and checks exact current P/A/content/scope, immutable certificate closure, epoch/control/registry/dependency/current relationship and lifecycle. CONTINUE additionally compares the latest binding exact P/A/scope; all typed operations bind requested latest immutable binding identity/revision, RESUME appends a new immutable S45 and preserves START. No provider/model/network wait or reverse registry acquisition is introduced.
verification.ordinary_pause: Separate non-granting internal descriptor permits only S01/S44 plus receipt/event/outbox. Under S01/exact S44/receipt it binds authenticated TEST subject/principal/policy/environment/role, command key, APP_STARTED, original START existence, latest same-subject immutable START-or-RESUME identity/hash and IN_PROGRESS expected execution revision. Restricted writes require exactly PAUSED/revision+1 and this event execution_basis_event_id; event and outcome contain reason/binding. No S51/current A/current head eligibility, S45/new authorization/actual/control/epoch mutation or generic patch is granted. Seven raw pause positives show lock stages [20,70,80], retained immutable binding and no authority grant; cases after expiry/control/head change/global revoke keep eligibility denied, and S51-blocked pause completes. Fresh duplicate state/conflict/identity/revision and injected failures deny or roll back; replay after RESUME returns original paused revision without mutating current state.
verification.replay_and_rollback: Authenticated registration/owner guard precedes all history lookup. Same-key history preserves original bundle/member/issuance/binding identities and executable=false. Changed payload conflicts. Fresh current operation cannot use cached eligibility as bearer; historical fallback is allowed only when the failed transaction is IDLE after rollback. Two actual duplicate barriers and eight atomicity/history cases establish no duplicate receipt/event/outbox or partial bundle.
